summary: Re-verified Moonlight Neurocare Stage A after re-hosting. Backend pytest suite (7 tests) all passed. Frontend E2E: home renders, /login shows three personas, demo login works for Parent, Care team, and Admin (each lands on correct portal route), session persists after reload (GET /api/auth/me), logout clears session (verified auth/me=401 after Sign out). Public health and settings endpoints OK. Enquiry lifecycle (create, idempotency, validation, admin visibility, stage update) verified via pytest.
critical_code_review_comments: test_stage_a_core_flows.py reads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from OS env at import time; when running pytest in supervisor shell the var isn't inherited. Pytest must be invoked with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported (documented for next agent). Consider reading from backend WEB_ORIGIN or loading /app/frontend/.env in the test module to make it self-contained.
test_credentials: Passwordless persona demo via /login (Parent/Care team/Admin) - see /app/memory/test_credentials.md
seed_data_creation: Per-sandbox seed via POST /api/auth/demo (isolated by mnc_demo cookie). No shared seed modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To run backend suite: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://launch-pad-416.preview.emergentagent.com pytest /app/backend/tests/test_stage_a_core_flows.py -v`. Frontend deployed at https://launch-pad-416.preview.emergentagent.com. Console 401 errors on public pages are expected (GET /api/auth/me before login). Booking modal fields: input placeholders differ from `name` attributes; open modal from 'Book an assessment' CTA to inspect if writing new UI tests. Storage/image upload in Admin Settings intentionally deferred (Stage A) - do not treat as blocker.
